messages:
jon.p: Heads up 1 marketplace vendor (MarketplacePartners) sent a retro rebate on Jan usage and our billing engine applied it as an immediate invoice discount. Invoice REF-2026-01 shows EUR 25,000 rebate (system recorded as -EUR25k on invoice). Accounting question: should this be an expense/rebate recognized immediately or a deferred vendor credit tied to future services?

sasha.t: Do we have contract language? If rebate is conditional on future purchases or service delivery, it should be deferred. If it's a pure refund, it's immediate.

jon.p: Contract clause 4.3: "Rebates apply against future platform fees over the next 6 months." So deferral required. Billing applied it on invoice generation because rule treats it like a credit memo.

rachel.g: Estimated USD impact at month-end? FX note: EUR 25k * 1.15 = USD 28,750 current booking. Need to decide FX measurement: book accrual at spot on invoice date and revalue monthly?

jon.p: Invoice date FX rate used by billing = 1.15, so USD equivalent = 28,750. We'll book accrual in USD at that rate and revalue any P&L FX on settlement.

sasha.t: Suggested JE to reverse immediate discount and record vendor accrual then move to deferred vendor credit (liability) until applied to future invoices:
```
Dr Sales Discounts (6100)         $28,750
  Cr Accrued Vendor Rebates (2208) $28,750
```
Then monthly recognition when rebates are applied to revenue: reduce liability and record reduction of revenue allowance over 6 months => $4,791.67/mo.

mike.l: Approval threshold check: if below $30k, I can approve operational accruals. This is $28,750 so I'm good as long as billing ticket exists and QA completed.

rachel.g: Please include the contract excerpt and billing export in the JE support. Also note the change in revenue schedule: move $28,750 from current period to deferred vendor rebates and amortize over 6 months starting Feb.

jon.p: I'll open a billing ticket to patch invoice treatment and attach the contract. Also need to create credit memo CM-2026-0072 to reflect vendor-initiated rebate (internally) and keep audit trail.

finance-bot: Ticket FIN-9420 created by jon.p linking REF-2026-01 and CM-2026-0072.

sasha.t: For close pack language: "Reverse immediate rebate applied to REF-2026-01; book accrued vendor rebate liability $28,750 (USD), issue internal credit memo CM-2026-0072; amortize rebate over 6 months (Feb-Jul) at $4,791.67/month. FX to be measured at invoice date; revaluation on settlement."

mike.l: I approve the accrual and amortization approach. QA from Billing required; tag me once PR to pricing rules merges.

jon.p: Will prepare JE in NetSuite with FIN-9420 and billing export attached, and update the revenue schedules spreadsheet. Will ping when JE posted.

sasha.t: One more: please scan for other marketplace vendors with similar clause. If there are more, we may need a policy update and a COR (change to billing rules).

jon.p: I'll run a query and add results to the billing ticket. Thanks everyone.
